format.file: {format, spec, cases: [case]}; every case runs on its own, from an empty engine, with risk inert (ignore_risk).
format.tokens: the mints table as c1b's, plus complete_slot (the token's historical completion, null: none) and pool (its PumpSwap pool, null: none), which the engine's graduation reads (engine.py:977-992).
format.cost_scenario: the journal's state 'cost_scenario' as paper.engine main writes it (json.dumps(asdict(scn), sort_keys=True), engine.py:1494): the base scenario of week2-defaults.yaml. Parse it with float_roundtrip.
format.expect_ops: every journal write of the five tables in the engine's order: ["put", table, row] with the table's columns (journal.py TABLES; null where the engine writes none) or ["delete", "positions", key]. The final positions table is empty.
format.integers: every integer fits i64; ret is a float, parse it with float_roundtrip.
format.case: name, why, clock, dev_bounds, groups, labels, tokens, pools, events (as in c2_position_cases.json FORMAT), learn, cost_scenario, expect_ops. tokens and pools are the snapshot: what the feed knows at the start.
format.learn: what the feed learns while it reads, in order: {at_slot, token} (a tokens row: the token is replaced), {at_slot, pool} (a pools row: added when the pool is not known yet, as a SOL market when its quote_class is sol or reversed) or {at_slot, epoch, ms} (the epoch's ms per slot in the engine's clock). An item applies right before the first event whose slot is >= at_slot, after the last event when there is none (lab/core: learn_token, learn_pool, set_epoch_ms before that push).

cases.name: pool_learned_mid_run
cases.why: P1 is in the snapshot (the control). P2 is learned with its first trade (t + 70): its trigger at t + 100 enters. P3 is learned with the first event after its trigger slot (O at t + 201): the end of t + 200 runs when that event arrives, after the learn, so P3's trigger enters too. P4 is learned with the event after that (O at t + 302), past the end of its trigger slot t + 300: no row for it. C, a curve token created after the snapshot, is learned with its first trade: its trigger at t + 400 enters.

cases.name: graduation_learned_after_the_entry
cases.why: H's snapshot row has no completion and no pool, and its pool PH is not known. Our entry (t + 2) fills when O's event at t + 3 arrives; the feed then learns H's completion at t + 10 and migration to PH, and PH (created t + 150), with the whale's event at t + 10. That buy, re-run after ours, completes the curve: the sale waits for PH and fills at its open + 1, t + 151; cf_graduation is 0, as H completed at that slot.

cases.name: completion_learned_too_late
cases.why: K as H in graduation_learned_after_the_entry, but the feed learns K's completion and pool only with O's second event (t + 14), after the whale's buy completed the curve at t + 10 (that slot ends when O's first event, t + 12, arrives): the sale is in the seed pool at t + 11, cf_graduation 1.

cases.why: Epoch 1042 starts at dev2's 267.83 ms a slot: P's trigger at t enters at t + 2 with tp4_T600's cap 599. The feed then learns 150 ms a slot (at t + 50): Q's trigger at t + 100 enters at t + 4 after it, with the cap 1,069; P's position keeps its cap.
